title: Penstock policy pack
description: The policy.json at the top of a policy pack folder (.penstock/policy by default). A pack is data only: it holds the rules, severities, conventions, palette, element templates and baselines a team shares, and penstock policy pin records a hash of every file in the folder so that a change to any of them is seen. Nothing in a pack is run, and a plugin or script entry is refused.

$schema.description: The address of this schema, for editors.

name.description: The name editors and findings show, for example acme-bpmn-standards. Letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores.

version.description: The version of the policy; raise it when the pack changes.

rules.description: The bpmnlint rules the pack sets, by rule name as it is written in .bpmnlintrc, for example label-required or camunda-compat/user-task-form.

forced.description: When true the project may not turn the rule off or lower its severity, and a pipeline fails if it does. Not allowed together with off.

conventions.description: The conventions for ids and for the defaults of new elements, as penstock.yaml has them. The project may add to them.

fromName.description: Name the id of a new element after its name.

pattern.description: The id pattern, with {Type} and {Name}. It is a template, never a regular expression.

defaults.description: Properties a new element of a type starts with, by BPMN type.

palette.description: The most the palette may offer. A project may narrow it and a pipeline fails when it widens it.

templates.description: Folders or files of the pack, relative to it, that hold element templates; they are added to the project's element templates.

baselines.description: Files of the pack, relative to it, in the format of penstock-baseline.json; findings they accept are not reported.

requiredChecks.description: What a pipeline requires before penstock check passes with this policy.

check.description: The check itself passes. On unless set to false.

scenarios.description: penstock scenarios run was run on the current files and passed.

dmnTests.description: penstock test dmn was run on the current files and passed.

receipt.description: Every change an agent made has a valid receipt.
